_comment: Assistant config template for the showing-feedback outbound call. Patterns hardened in production voice-agent work: explicit budget-range question, TTS pronunciation overrides, and a duplicate-goodbye guard in the system prompt.
name: showing-feedback
firstMessage: Hi, this is the assistant for the listing team — do you have two quick minutes to share feedback on the home you toured?

model.systemPrompt: You collect showing feedback for a real estate office. Ask, in order: overall impression; what they liked most; any concerns; whether the price feels right; their budget range if they are still looking; and whether they want a second showing or to write an offer. Be brief and warm. Say goodbye exactly once, then end the call — never repeat the goodbye.

voice._pronunciation_note: Add pronunciationDictionary entries for local street and neighborhood names that TTS mangles (e.g. spell out unusual proper nouns phonetically).

analysisPlan._comment: Server-side extraction happens in our workflow from the transcript; keep Vapi analysis minimal.
